recipes.name: Berry Greek Yogurt Overnight Oats
steps: Stir the oats, Greek yogurt, milk, chia seeds, honey and cinnamon together in a big bowl.
Split into 5 jars and top each with a handful of frozen berries (they thaw overnight).
Lid and refrigerate. Eat cold, straight from the jar, within 5 days.

recipes.name: Veggie Cheddar Egg Muffins
steps: Heat the oven to 350°F and grease a 12-cup muffin tin.
Chop the spinach, pepper and onion small and divide them between the cups.
Whisk the eggs with garlic powder, salt and pepper, pour over the vegetables, and top with cheddar.
Bake 20 to 22 minutes until set in the middle. Cool, then refrigerate 3 per serving.

recipes.name: Black Bean Breakfast Burritos
steps: Scramble the eggs over medium-low heat until just set; season with cumin, salt and pepper.
Warm the drained black beans with the salsa for 2 minutes.
Fill each tortilla with eggs, beans and cheese, roll tightly, and wrap in foil.
Refrigerate up to 4 days or freeze. Reheat 1 to 2 minutes in the microwave (foil off).

recipes.name: Peanut Butter Banana Baked Oatmeal
steps: Heat the oven to 375°F and grease an 8x8 baking dish.
Mash the bananas, then whisk in the eggs, milk, peanut butter, honey and cinnamon.
Stir in the oats and pour into the dish.
Bake about 30 minutes until golden and set. Cut into 6 squares.

recipes.name: Sweet Potato & Egg Breakfast Hash
steps: Dice the sweet potatoes small and cook them in the oil over medium heat, covered, for 10 minutes.
Add the diced onion and pepper and the paprika; cook uncovered 8 more minutes until browned.
Make 8 wells, crack in the eggs, cover and cook 5 to 7 minutes until the whites set.
Split into 4 containers, 2 eggs each.

recipes.name: High-Protein Yogurt Parfait Jars
steps: Toast the oats in a dry pan for 3 minutes and let them cool.
Stir the honey into the Greek yogurt.
Layer yogurt, berries, oats and chia in 5 jars, with a spoon of peanut butter on top.
Refrigerate. Keep the oats on top so they stay a bit crunchy.

recipes.name: Chicken Burrito Bowls
steps: Cook the rice. Toss the chicken in the taco seasoning and oil.
Sear the chicken 6 to 7 minutes a side until 165°F inside; rest, then slice.
Warm the drained beans and the corn together.
Divide rice, beans and corn, chicken and salsa into 6 containers; squeeze lime over.

recipes.name: Sheet-Pan Chicken, Sweet Potatoes & Broccoli
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F. Cube the sweet potatoes, toss with half the oil and spices, and roast 15 minutes.
Cut the chicken into chunks and the broccoli into florets; toss with the rest of the oil and spices.
Add both to the pan and roast 15 to 18 minutes more, until the chicken is cooked through.
Divide between 5 containers.

recipes.name: Honey Garlic Chicken, Rice & Green Beans
steps: Cook the rice. Mix honey, soy sauce, minced garlic, cornstarch and 1/4 cup water.
Brown the chicken thighs 5 minutes a side in a hot pan.
Pour in the sauce and simmer 5 minutes until sticky and the chicken reaches 165°F.
Steam the green beans. Pack rice, chicken with sauce, and green beans into 6 containers.

recipes.name: Chicken & Veggie Stir-Fry
steps: Cook the rice. Slice the chicken thin and toss it with the cornstarch.
Stir-fry the chicken in a very hot pan for 5 minutes; take it out.
Stir-fry the broccoli, sliced peppers and carrots 4 minutes, then add garlic and ginger.
Return the chicken, add soy sauce, honey and sesame oil, toss 1 minute, and pack over rice.

recipes.name: Greek Chicken Bowls with Yogurt Sauce
steps: Cook the rice. Rub the chicken with oil, oregano, half the lemon juice, salt and pepper.
Cook the chicken 6 to 7 minutes a side until 165°F; rest and slice.
Stir the Greek yogurt with grated garlic, the rest of the lemon juice, a little grated cucumber and salt.
Pack rice, chicken, chopped cucumber, tomatoes and red onion, with the sauce on the side.

recipes.name: Sheet-Pan Chicken Fajitas
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F. Slice the chicken, peppers and onion into strips.
Toss everything with oil and taco seasoning on a big sheet pan.
Roast 20 minutes, stirring once, until the chicken is cooked and the peppers char at the edges.
Squeeze lime over. Pack with 2 tortillas per serving.

recipes.name: Easy Chicken Tikka-Style Curry
steps: Cook the rice. Soften the chopped onion in a big pot for 5 minutes, then add garlic, ginger and curry powder for 1 minute.
Add the chicken in chunks and cook 5 minutes.
Pour in the crushed tomatoes and coconut milk and simmer 15 minutes.
Stir in the peas and the yogurt off the heat. Serve over rice.

recipes.name: Lemon Pepper Chicken, Potatoes & Green Beans
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F. Cut the potatoes into chunks, toss with half the oil, and roast 20 minutes.
Rub the chicken with the rest of the oil, lemon zest, garlic powder and lots of black pepper.
Add the chicken and green beans to the pan and roast 18 to 20 minutes.
Squeeze the lemons over everything and divide into 5 containers.

recipes.name: Buffalo Chicken Stuffed Sweet Potatoes
steps: Pierce the sweet potatoes and bake at 400°F for 40 minutes (or microwave 10 to 12).
Meanwhile poach the chicken in simmering water 15 minutes, then shred it and toss with the hot sauce.
Stir the yogurt with garlic powder and a pinch of salt for a cool sauce.
Split each potato, fill with buffalo chicken, and top with sauce and green onions.

recipes.name: Chicken, Spinach & Tomato Pasta
steps: Boil the pasta; save a cup of the water before draining.
Cook bite-size chicken with Italian seasoning in the oil for 7 minutes.
Add garlic and halved tomatoes for 3 minutes, then the spinach until it wilts.
Toss in the pasta, parmesan and a splash of pasta water. Divide into 6.

recipes.name: Teriyaki Chicken & Broccoli Bowls
steps: Cook the rice. Whisk soy sauce, honey, garlic, ginger, cornstarch and 1/2 cup water.
Cook the chicken in chunks 7 to 8 minutes until browned.
Pour in the sauce and simmer 2 minutes until glossy.
Steam the broccoli and pack it with rice and teriyaki chicken.

recipes.name: Hearty Chicken Noodle Soup
steps: Soften the chopped onion, carrots and celery in a big pot for 6 minutes; add garlic.
Add the broth, whole chicken breasts and Italian seasoning; simmer 20 minutes.
Lift out the chicken and shred it. Add the pasta and cook 8 minutes.
Return the chicken, season with salt and pepper, and portion into 6.

recipes.name: BBQ Chicken, Corn & Roasted Potatoes
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F. Roast the potato chunks with oil and paprika for 20 minutes.
Add the chicken to the pan, brush it with half the BBQ sauce, and roast 18 minutes.
Warm the corn. Brush the chicken with the rest of the sauce and slice.
Divide chicken, potatoes and corn into 5 containers.

recipes.name: Chicken Enchilada Skillet
steps: Brown diced chicken and onion in a large skillet for 7 minutes.
Stir in the tomato sauce, chili powder, cumin, beans and corn; simmer 5 minutes.
Tear the tortillas into pieces and fold them in.
Top with cheddar, cover 3 minutes to melt, and portion into 6.

recipes.name: Turkey & Three-Bean Chili
steps: Brown the turkey with the chopped onion and pepper for 8 minutes.
Add the garlic, chili powder and cumin for 1 minute.
Add the beans (drained), crushed tomatoes and 1 cup water; simmer 25 minutes.
Taste for salt. Portion into 8; it freezes well.

recipes.name: One-Pot Turkey Taco Rice
steps: Brown the turkey with the taco seasoning in a deep pan.
Stir in the rice, salsa and broth; bring to a boil.
Cover and simmer on low 18 minutes until the rice is tender.
Stir in the beans and corn, top with cheddar, and portion into 6.

recipes.name: Egg Roll in a Bowl (Turkey & Cabbage)
steps: Cook the rice. Brown the turkey in a large pan.
Add garlic and ginger for 1 minute, then the shredded cabbage and grated carrots.
Stir-fry 6 minutes until the cabbage softens. Add soy sauce, sriracha and sesame oil.
Top with green onions and pack with a scoop of rice.

recipes.name: Turkey Meatballs & Whole Wheat Spaghetti
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F. Mix the turkey, egg, oats, parmesan, Italian seasoning and garlic; roll 24 meatballs.
Bake 18 minutes. Boil the pasta.
Simmer the meatballs in the marinara 5 minutes.
Toss with the pasta and divide into 6.

recipes.name: Beef & Broccoli Rice Bowls
steps: Cook the rice. Whisk soy sauce, honey, cornstarch and 1/3 cup water.
Brown the beef with garlic and ginger, breaking it up.
Add the broccoli florets and 2 tablespoons water; cover and steam 4 minutes.
Pour in the sauce, toss until glossy, and pack over rice.

recipes.name: Hidden-Veggie Beef Bolognese
steps: Grate the carrots and zucchini and chop the onion.
Brown the beef, then add the vegetables and garlic and cook 8 minutes.
Add crushed tomatoes and Italian seasoning; simmer 20 minutes. Boil the pasta meanwhile.
Toss pasta with sauce, add parmesan, and divide into 6.

recipes.name: Turkey & Rice Stuffed Peppers
steps: Cook the rice. Heat the oven to 375°F. Cut the tops off the peppers and scoop out the seeds.
Brown the turkey with chopped onion; stir in the rice, most of the tomato sauce and the seasoning.
Stuff the peppers, spoon the rest of the sauce on top, cover with foil, and bake 30 minutes.
Add cheddar and bake 5 more minutes uncovered.

recipes.name: Turkey Shepherd's Pie
steps: Boil the peeled potato chunks 15 minutes, then mash with the milk and salt.
Brown the turkey with the onion and garlic; add the frozen vegetables, broth and tomato sauce and simmer 5 minutes.
Stir in the cornstarch mixed with a little water to thicken.
Spread in a baking dish, top with mash, and bake at 400°F for 20 minutes.

recipes.name: Pork Tenderloin with Roasted Carrots & Potatoes
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F. Toss potato chunks and carrot sticks with 2 tablespoons oil and roast 15 minutes.
Rub the pork with mustard, honey, garlic and the rest of the oil.
Add the pork to the pan and roast 20 to 25 minutes, to 145°F inside. Rest 5 minutes and slice.
Divide into 6.

recipes.name: Cilantro-Lime Pork Carnitas Bowls
steps: Cut the pork into 2-inch chunks and rub with cumin, oregano, garlic and salt.
Simmer covered in 1 cup water and the juice of 1 lime for 30 minutes, then shred and crisp in a hot pan.
Cook the rice and stir in chopped cilantro and the other lime's juice.
Pack rice, beans, pork and salsa into 7 containers.

recipes.name: Lemony Tuna & White Bean Salad
steps: Drain the tuna and beans.
Chop the cucumber, halve the tomatoes and slice the red onion thin.
Toss everything with lemon juice, olive oil, oregano, salt and pepper.
Keeps 3 days in the fridge; no cooking needed.

recipes.name: Shrimp Fried Rice
steps: Cook the rice ahead and let it cool (day-old rice fries best).
Cook the shrimp 2 minutes a side and set aside.
Scramble the eggs, push aside, then stir-fry the vegetables and garlic 3 minutes.
Add the rice, soy sauce and sesame oil; fry 4 minutes. Return the shrimp and add green onions.

recipes.name: Soy-Honey Salmon, Rice & Broccoli
steps: Cook the rice. Heat the oven to 400°F.
Mix soy sauce, honey and garlic; brush it over the salmon on a sheet pan.
Toss the broccoli with the oil around the fish and bake 12 to 15 minutes.
Pack salmon, broccoli and rice into 4 containers.

recipes.name: Garlic Shrimp & Spinach Pasta
steps: Boil the pasta; keep a cup of the water.
Cook the garlic in the oil 1 minute, add the shrimp and cook 2 minutes a side.
Add the spinach until wilted, then the pasta, lemon juice, parmesan and a splash of pasta water.
Toss and divide into 5.

recipes.name: Greek Yogurt Tuna Pasta Salad
steps: Boil the pasta, adding the frozen peas for the last 2 minutes; rinse under cold water.
Stir the yogurt with mustard, lemon juice, salt and pepper.
Fold in the drained tuna, chopped celery and red onion, pasta and peas.
Chill and divide into 5.

recipes.name: Red Lentil Coconut Curry
steps: Cook the rice. Soften the onion 5 minutes, then add garlic, ginger and curry powder for 1 minute.
Add the rinsed lentils, crushed tomatoes, coconut milk and 3 cups water; simmer 20 minutes, stirring.
Stir in the spinach until wilted and season with salt.
Serve over rice; it thickens as it cools.

recipes.name: Lentil & Sweet Potato Soup
steps: Soften the chopped onion and carrots 5 minutes; add the garlic and spices.
Add the lentils, diced sweet potatoes and broth; simmer 30 minutes until tender.
Stir in the spinach, season with salt and pepper.
Portion into 6; freezes well.

recipes.name: Black Bean & Sweet Potato Burrito Bowls
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F. Roast cubed sweet potatoes with oil, cumin and chili powder for 25 minutes.
Cook the rice. Warm the drained beans with the corn.
Pack rice, sweet potatoes, beans and corn, and salsa into 6 containers, with a spoon of Greek yogurt as sour cream.
Add sliced avocado and lime just before eating.

recipes.name: Chickpea & Spinach Curry
steps: Cook the rice. Soften the onion 5 minutes; add garlic, ginger and curry powder.
Add the drained chickpeas, crushed tomatoes and coconut milk; simmer 15 minutes.
Stir in the spinach and season with salt.
Serve over rice.

recipes.name: Peanut Tofu & Veggie Stir-Fry
steps: Cook the rice. Press the tofu dry, cube it, and toss with the cornstarch.
Fry the tofu in a non-stick pan until golden on all sides, about 10 minutes.
Stir-fry the vegetables and garlic 5 minutes.
Whisk peanut butter, soy sauce, honey, lime juice and 1/4 cup hot water; toss everything and pack over rice.

recipes.name: Spanish Chickpeas & Rice
steps: Soften the onion and pepper in the oil 5 minutes; add garlic and smoked paprika.
Stir in the rice to coat, then the tomatoes, chickpeas and broth.
Cover and simmer on low 20 minutes.
Stir in the peas, rest 5 minutes covered, and portion into 6.

recipes.name: Veggie Egg Fried Rice
steps: Cook the rice ahead and let it cool.
Scramble the eggs in a hot pan and push them aside.
Stir-fry the frozen vegetables and garlic 4 minutes.
Add the rice, soy sauce and sesame oil; fry 4 minutes and finish with green onions.

recipes.name: Greek Chickpea Quinoa Salad Jars
steps: Cook the quinoa in 2 cups water for 15 minutes; cool.
Whisk lemon juice, olive oil, oregano, salt and pepper in the bottom of 5 jars.
Layer chickpeas, cucumber, red onion, tomatoes, quinoa and feta.
Shake into a bowl to eat. Keeps 4 days.

recipes.name: White Bean & Kale Soup
steps: Soften the onion and carrots 6 minutes; add garlic and Italian seasoning.
Add the beans, tomatoes and broth; simmer 15 minutes. Mash a few beans to thicken.
Add the chopped kale for 5 minutes.
Serve with parmesan on top.

recipes.name: Black Bean & Spinach Quesadillas
steps: Mash half the beans with cumin, then stir in the rest with the corn and chopped spinach.
Spread on 4 tortillas, top with cheese, and close with the other 4.
Toast in a dry pan 3 minutes a side until golden and melted.
Cut into wedges and pack with salsa.

recipes.name: Lentil Sloppy Joes
steps: Simmer the lentils in 3 cups water 20 minutes until tender; drain.
Soften the onion and pepper 5 minutes with the garlic.
Add the lentils, tomato sauce, honey, mustard and chili powder; simmer 10 minutes until thick.
Pack with buns on the side.

recipes.name: Pasta e Fagioli
steps: Soften the onion, carrots and celery 6 minutes; add garlic.
Add the beans, tomatoes and broth; simmer 10 minutes.
Add the pasta and cook 9 minutes, then the spinach.
Top with parmesan; add a splash of water when reheating.

recipes.name: Cottage Cheese & Spinach Baked Ziti
steps: Heat the oven to 375°F. Boil the pasta 2 minutes short of done.
Stir the cottage cheese with the egg, chopped spinach and Italian seasoning.
Layer pasta, marinara, the cottage cheese mix and mozzarella in a 9x13 dish.
Bake 25 minutes until bubbling. Cut into 8.

recipes.name: Turkey, Zucchini & Quinoa Skillet
steps: Brown the turkey with onion and garlic.
Add the rinsed quinoa, tomatoes, broth and spices; cover and simmer 15 minutes.
Stir in diced zucchini, cover, and cook 5 more minutes.
Portion into 5.

recipes.name: Herby Lemon Chicken Quinoa Bowls
steps: Cook the quinoa. Season the chicken with Italian seasoning and 1 tablespoon oil.
Cook the chicken 6 to 7 minutes a side; rest and slice.
Whisk the rest of the oil with lemon juice, salt and pepper.
Pack spinach, quinoa, chicken, tomatoes, cucumber and feta; dress when eating.

recipes.name: Black Bean & Quinoa Chili (Vegan)
steps: Soften the onion and pepper in a big pot 6 minutes; add the garlic, chili powder and cumin for 1 minute.
Add the rinsed quinoa, crushed tomatoes, drained beans and vegetable broth.
Simmer 25 minutes, stirring now and then, until the quinoa is tender and the chili is thick.
Stir in the corn for 3 minutes and season with salt. Portion into 6; it freezes well.

recipes.name: Chickpea & Black Bean Burrito Bowls (Vegan)
steps: Cook the rice and stir in chopped cilantro and the juice of one lime.
Pan-fry the drained chickpeas in the oil with the cumin and chili powder 6 minutes until crisp at the edges.
Warm the black beans with the corn.
Pack rice, chickpeas, beans and corn, and salsa; add sliced avocado and lime when you eat.

recipes.name: Coconut Chickpea & Sweet Potato Stew (Vegan)
steps: Cook the rice. Soften the onion 5 minutes, then add the garlic, ginger and curry powder for 1 minute.
Add the diced sweet potatoes, chickpeas, tomatoes, coconut milk and vegetable broth.
Simmer 20 minutes until the sweet potato is soft.
Stir in the spinach until wilted and serve over rice.

recipes.name: Lentil & Mushroom Bolognese (Vegan)
steps: Finely chop the mushrooms, carrots and onion and soften them in the oil 8 minutes; add the garlic.
Add the lentils, crushed tomatoes, Italian seasoning and 2 cups water; simmer 30 minutes until the lentils are tender.
Boil the pasta meanwhile.
Toss together and divide into 6.

recipes.name: Kung Pao Chicken
steps: Cook the rice. Cut the chicken into bite-size pieces and toss with 1 tablespoon cornstarch and 1 tablespoon soy sauce.
Whisk the rest of the soy sauce with the honey, rice vinegar, chili garlic sauce, the other tablespoon of cornstarch and 1/4 cup water.
Sear the chicken in a very hot oiled pan 5 to 6 minutes until browned; add the diced peppers, garlic and ginger for 2 minutes.
Pour in the sauce and stir until it thickens and coats everything, about 1 minute.
Stir in the peanuts and green onions and pack over rice.

recipes.name: Lighter Orange Chicken & Broccoli
steps: Cook the rice. Zest one orange, then juice both (about 2/3 cup).
Toss bite-size chicken with 2 tablespoons cornstarch and a pinch of salt; pan-fry in a little oil 6 to 7 minutes until golden and cooked through.
Whisk the orange juice and zest, honey, soy sauce, vinegar, garlic, ginger and the last tablespoon of cornstarch; pour over the chicken and simmer 2 minutes until glossy.
Steam the broccoli and pack with the rice and orange chicken.

recipes.name: Chicken Lo Mein
steps: Boil the spaghetti until just tender; drain and toss with 1 teaspoon sesame oil.
Stir-fry thin strips of chicken in a hot oiled pan 5 minutes; add the garlic.
Add shredded cabbage, matchstick carrots and sliced pepper; stir-fry 3 minutes so they stay crisp.
Add the noodles, soy sauce, hoisin and the rest of the sesame oil; toss 2 minutes and finish with green onions.

recipes.name: Mapo-Style Tofu with Pork
steps: Cook the rice. Cut the tofu into 1-inch cubes.
Brown the pork in a deep pan, breaking it up, 5 minutes. Add garlic, ginger and chili garlic sauce for 1 minute.
Add the broth and soy sauce, then slide in the tofu and simmer gently 5 minutes (stir carefully so it doesn't break).
Stir in the cornstarch mixed with 2 tablespoons water until the sauce thickens. Top with green onions; serve over rice.

recipes.name: Chinese Tomato & Egg Stir-Fry
steps: Cook the rice. Beat the eggs with a pinch of salt; cut the tomatoes into wedges.
Scramble the eggs in the oil over medium heat until just set, then slide them onto a plate.
Cook the tomatoes 3 to 4 minutes until juicy; add the honey, soy sauce and the cornstarch mixed with 1/4 cup water.
When the sauce thickens, fold the eggs back in with the green onions. Serve over rice.

recipes.name: Cashew Chicken
steps: Cook the rice. Toss bite-size chicken with the cornstarch.
Sear the chicken in a hot oiled pan 5 minutes; take it out.
Stir-fry the onion, pepper and broccoli with the garlic 4 minutes.
Return the chicken, add soy sauce, hoisin and 3 tablespoons water, toss until glossy, then stir in the cashews. Pack over rice.

recipes.name: Pork & Cabbage Dumpling Bowls
steps: Cook the rice. Brown the pork in a large pan 6 minutes; spoon off any extra fat.
Add the garlic and ginger for 1 minute, then the shredded cabbage and grated carrots; stir-fry 5 minutes.
Season with soy sauce, rice vinegar and sesame oil (it tastes like dumpling filling).
Top with green onions and pack over rice.

recipes.name: Sweet & Sour Pork with Pineapple
steps: Cook the rice. Cut the pork into bite-size pieces and toss with 1 tablespoon cornstarch.
Brown the pork in a hot oiled pan 6 minutes; add chunks of pepper and onion for 3 minutes.
Whisk the juice from the pineapple can with the vinegar, honey, soy sauce, tomato paste and the other tablespoon of cornstarch.
Add the pineapple chunks and the sauce; simmer 2 minutes until thick and glossy. Serve over rice.

recipes.name: Peanut Noodles with Chicken & Veggies
steps: Boil the spaghetti and rinse it in cold water. Poach the chicken 15 minutes in simmering water, then shred it.
Whisk the peanut butter, soy sauce, honey, vinegar, sriracha and 1/4 cup hot water until smooth.
Toss the noodles with the sauce, chicken, shredded cabbage, grated carrots and sliced cucumber.
Top with green onions. Good cold or warm.

recipes.name: Chicken Tortilla Soup
steps: Soften the onion and jalapeño in a big pot 5 minutes; add the garlic, cumin and chili powder.
Add the broth, tomatoes and whole chicken breasts; simmer 20 minutes, then shred the chicken in the pot.
Add the beans and corn and simmer 5 more minutes; squeeze in the lime.
Cut the tortillas into strips and bake at 400°F for 8 minutes until crisp. Pack them separately to sprinkle on top.

recipes.name: Chicken Tinga Tacos
steps: Simmer the chicken thighs in salted water 20 minutes, then shred.
Cook the sliced onion 5 minutes. Blend the tomatoes, chipotle, garlic and oregano and pour it in.
Simmer the sauce 5 minutes, then stir in the chicken until it's coated and saucy.
Warm the tortillas and pack with the tinga, shredded cabbage and lime wedges.

recipes.name: Black Bean & Spinach Enchiladas
steps: Heat the oven to 375°F. Mash half the beans with the cumin, then mix in the rest with the corn and chopped spinach.
Spread a little enchilada sauce in a baking dish. Fill and roll the tortillas and lay them seam-side down.
Pour the rest of the sauce over and top with the cheddar.
Bake 20 minutes until bubbling. 2 enchiladas per serving.

recipes.name: Beef Burrito Bowls
steps: Cook the rice and stir in chopped cilantro and the lime juice.
Brown the beef with the taco seasoning and 1/3 cup water until saucy, about 8 minutes.
Warm the beans and corn together.
Pack rice, beef, beans and corn, and salsa into 6 containers.

recipes.name: Shrimp Tacos with Lime Slaw
steps: Toss the shrimp with the oil, chili powder, cumin and salt.
Mix the shredded cabbage with the Greek yogurt, the juice of one lime and a pinch of salt.
Cook the shrimp in a hot pan 2 minutes a side until pink.
Warm the tortillas and fill with shrimp, slaw and sliced avocado. Pack the slaw separately so the tortillas stay dry.

recipes.name: Beef & Bean Burrito Bake
steps: Cook the rice. Heat the oven to 375°F.
Brown the beef with the taco seasoning; stir in the beans, salsa and half the enchilada sauce.
Layer torn tortillas, rice and the beef mixture in a baking dish; pour the rest of the sauce on top and add the cheddar.
Bake 20 minutes. Cut into 6.

recipes.name: Steak Fajita Bowls
steps: Cook the rice. Rub the steak with half the taco seasoning and 1 tablespoon oil.
Sear the steak in a very hot pan 4 minutes a side for medium; rest 5 minutes, then slice thin across the grain.
Cook the sliced peppers and onion with the rest of the seasoning and oil 6 minutes until charred at the edges.
Pack rice, peppers and steak, and squeeze lime over.

recipes.name: Korean-Style Beef Bowls
steps: Cook the rice. Brown the beef 6 minutes.
Add the garlic and ginger for 1 minute, then the soy sauce, honey and sesame oil; simmer 2 minutes until sticky.
Slice the cucumber and grate the carrots.
Pack rice, beef and the crunchy vegetables; top with green onions.

recipes.name: Hearty Beef & Vegetable Stew
steps: Pat the beef dry, season with salt and pepper, and brown it in batches in the oil in a heavy pot.
Add the onion and celery for 5 minutes, then the tomato paste for 1 minute.
Add the broth and Italian seasoning; cover and simmer gently 1 hour.
Add chunks of potato and carrot and simmer 30 more minutes, then thicken with the cornstarch mixed in a little water.

recipes.name: Beef & Bean Chili
steps: Brown the beef with the onion and pepper 8 minutes.
Add the garlic, chili powder and cumin for 1 minute.
Add the drained beans, crushed tomatoes and 1 cup water; simmer 25 minutes.
Season with salt. Portion into 8; it freezes well.

recipes.name: Lean Meatloaf, Mashed Potatoes & Green Beans
steps: Heat the oven to 375°F. Mix the beef, oats, egg, grated onion, half the tomato sauce and the Italian seasoning; shape a loaf on a lined pan.
Spread the rest of the tomato sauce on top and bake 50 to 55 minutes, to 160°F inside.
Meanwhile boil the potato chunks 15 minutes and mash with the milk and salt.
Steam the green beans. Slice the meatloaf into 6 and pack with mash and beans.

recipes.name: Lighter Beef Stroganoff
steps: Boil the pasta. Brown the beef, then add the sliced mushrooms, onion and garlic and cook 8 minutes.
Add the broth and mustard and simmer 5 minutes; thicken with the cornstarch mixed in a little water.
Take the pan off the heat and stir in the Greek yogurt (off the heat so it stays creamy).
Toss with the pasta and divide into 6.

recipes.name: Honey Mustard Pork, Sweet Potatoes & Green Beans
steps: Heat the oven to 425°F. Roast cubed sweet potatoes with 1 tablespoon oil for 15 minutes.
Stir together the honey, mustard, garlic and the rest of the oil; brush most of it over the pork.
Add the pork and green beans to the pan; roast 20 to 25 minutes, to 145°F inside.
Brush with the rest of the glaze, rest 5 minutes, slice, and divide into 6.

recipes.name: Lighter Chicken Alfredo with Broccoli
steps: Boil the pasta, adding the broccoli for the last 3 minutes; drain.
Cook bite-size chicken in a little oil 7 minutes; add the garlic for 1 minute.
Whisk the milk with the cornstarch, pour it in, and stir until it simmers and thickens.
Off the heat, stir in the parmesan and Greek yogurt, then toss with the pasta and broccoli.

recipes.name: One-Pot Taco Pasta
steps: Brown the turkey with the taco seasoning in a deep pot.
Add the dry pasta, salsa and broth; bring to a boil.
Cover and simmer 12 minutes, stirring now and then, until the pasta is tender.
Stir in the beans and cheddar until melted. Portion into 6.

recipes.name: Turkey Lasagna Skillet
steps: Brown the turkey with the Italian seasoning in a large deep skillet.
Add the marinara, 2 cups water and the broken dry pasta; cover and simmer 14 minutes until tender.
Stir in the spinach. Dollop the cottage cheese on top and sprinkle the mozzarella.
Cover 3 minutes to melt. Portion into 6.

recipes.name: Lemon Garlic Chicken Orzo
steps: Cook bite-size chicken in the oil 6 minutes; add the garlic for 1 minute.
Add the orzo and broth; simmer uncovered 10 minutes, stirring, until the orzo is tender and creamy.
Stir in the spinach, lemon zest and juice, and the parmesan.
Season with salt and pepper and divide into 6.

recipes.name: Pasta Primavera with White Beans
steps: Boil the pasta and keep a cup of the water.
Cook the sliced zucchini and pepper in the oil 5 minutes; add the garlic and halved tomatoes for 3 minutes.
Add the beans, pasta, parmesan, lemon juice and a splash of the pasta water.
Toss until glossy and divide into 6.

recipes.name: Chicken Parmesan Pasta Bake
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F. Boil the pasta 2 minutes short of done.
Brown bite-size chicken with the Italian seasoning and garlic 6 minutes.
Mix the pasta, chicken and marinara in a baking dish; top with mozzarella and parmesan.
Bake 15 minutes until bubbling and golden. Cut into 6.

recipes.name: Lentil Marinara Pasta
steps: Soften the onion and garlic 5 minutes.
Add the lentils, marinara and 2 cups water; simmer 15 minutes until the lentils melt into a thick sauce.
Boil the pasta meanwhile.
Toss together, top with parmesan, and divide into 6.

recipes.name: Lighter Butter Chicken
steps: Cook the rice. Toss the chicken chunks with half the yogurt and 1 teaspoon curry powder.
Soften the onion 5 minutes; add the garlic, ginger, tomato paste and the rest of the curry powder for 1 minute.
Add the crushed tomatoes and the chicken; simmer 15 minutes.
Off the heat, stir in the milk and the rest of the yogurt. Serve over rice.

recipes.name: Turkey Keema with Peas
steps: Cook the rice. Soften the onion 5 minutes, then add the garlic, ginger and curry powder.
Add the turkey and brown it, breaking it up, 8 minutes.
Add the tomatoes and simmer 10 minutes.
Stir in the peas for 3 minutes. Serve over rice.

recipes.name: Shakshuka with Feta
steps: Soften the onion and peppers in the oil 8 minutes; add the garlic, cumin and paprika.
Add the crushed tomatoes and simmer 10 minutes until thick.
Make 12 wells, crack in the eggs, cover and cook 6 to 8 minutes until the whites set.
Top with feta. 2 eggs and sauce per serving, with a pita.

recipes.name: Chicken Shawarma Bowls
steps: Cook the rice. Rub the chicken with the oil, cumin, paprika, half the garlic, the juice of one lemon and salt.
Roast at 425°F for 20 to 22 minutes (or pan-fry), then slice.
Stir the yogurt with the rest of the garlic and lemon for a sauce.
Pack rice, chicken, chopped cucumber, tomato and red onion, with the sauce on the side.

recipes.name: Turkey Gyro Meatball Pitas
steps: Heat the oven to 400°F. Mix the turkey, oats, egg, oregano and two garlic cloves; roll 24 meatballs and bake 18 minutes.
Grate half the cucumber into the yogurt with the last garlic clove, the lemon juice and salt (tzatziki).
Chop the rest of the cucumber and the tomatoes.
Pack 4 meatballs, vegetables and tzatziki per serving with a pita.

recipes.name: Cuban-Style Rice, Black Beans & Eggs
steps: Cook the rice. Soften the onion and pepper in the oil 6 minutes; add the garlic, cumin and oregano.
Add the beans with half their liquid and simmer 10 minutes, mashing a few to thicken.
Boil the eggs 9 minutes (boiled eggs keep best for meal prep).
Pack rice, beans, an egg and a spoon of salsa per serving.

recipes.name: Potato, Spinach & Cheddar Frittata
steps: Heat the oven to 375°F. Cook thin potato slices and the onion in the oil in an ovenproof pan, covered, 10 minutes.
Add the spinach until wilted.
Pour in the eggs beaten with salt and pepper, top with cheddar, and cook 3 minutes on the stove.
Bake 15 minutes until set. Cut into 6 wedges.

recipes.name: Freezer Bean & Cheese Burritos
steps: Cook the rice. Mash the beans with the salsa and cumin over low heat until warm and thick.
Fill each tortilla with rice, beans and cheese; fold in the sides and roll tightly.
Wrap each in foil. Refrigerate up to 4 days or freeze up to 3 months.
Reheat from frozen: unwrap, cover with a damp paper towel, and microwave 2 to 3 minutes. 2 burritos per serving.
